policy: Allowlist of leaks that exist in the SOURCE datasets and cannot be resolved without altering a published benchmark. This is an explicit, per-pair exception list, NOT a loosened threshold: any leak not listed here by exact uid pair still fails tests/test_no_leakage.py. Every entry carries a reason. Leaks that CAN be fixed are fixed instead, by dropping the row from train (see deduplicate() in scripts/build_splits.py).
